payload.summary: 报警网关时钟偏移 +30 分钟，已执行 NTP 校正；报警时间戳不可信

payload.excerpt:
5.2 Bearing temperature monitoring. The bearing temperature alarm threshold is 80 C. Use
the 30-minute trend; a single spike is not sufficient for a mechanical conclusion.

5.3 Temperature sensor drift check. If bearing temperature rises while vibration RMS and
motor current remain stable, compare the reading with a handheld thermometer. A
difference above 5 C indicates sensor drift; replace the sensor.

6.1 Vibration limits. RMS above 4.5 mm/s indicates an abnormal mechanical condition. A
rising trend with increased motor current indicates bearing wear. Verify with oil
analysis and vibration spectrum.

7.1 Communication and sampling faults. Missing samples, out-of-order timestamps, or a
cleared communication alarm with normal process values indicate a data-path fault, not a
mechanical fault. Do not replace mechanical parts based on communication alarms alone.

hypotheses.title: 报警网关时钟偏移导致报警时间戳错误
hypotheses.description: MES记录报警网关时钟偏移+30分钟并已NTP校正，报警时间戳不可信；报警时间与趋势数据对不上由此解释。
hypotheses.rationale: ev_77bc65006fded7ac7d78明确记录时钟偏移+30分钟且报警时间戳不可信，直接解释现象；ev_ed4c063b1d128cc0a11b报警触发时间23:30落在窗口外，与窗口内正常温度趋势矛盾。
missing_evidence: 报警网关校正前后时间戳对照记录
hypotheses.next_check: 查询报警网关时钟校正前后时间戳对照与阈值配置

hypotheses.next_check: 查询报警清除记录与阈值配置

hypotheses.title: 轴承磨损/机械故障
hypotheses.description: 振动RMS与电流平稳、温度远低于阈值，不支持机械故障。
hypotheses.rationale: ev_cf0df289708ea9298750振动2.03–2.17mm/s远低于手册4.5mm/s，ev_037ca15df2910785d4bf电流平稳无上升趋势，ev_ad21bcc4f270b8108285温度61.62–62.37°C远低于80°C，ev_8a6b86e89092fbdc8eb4给出判据。

limitations: 报警时间戳因网关时钟偏移不可信，无法据此确定真实触发时刻。

缺少振动频谱与油液分析，机械类结论仅基于趋势量级判断。

30 分钟窗内轴承温度 min 61.62 / max 62.37 / avg 61.99°C，样本 30，缺失 0，远低于手册 80°C 报警阈值。
振动 RMS min 2.03 / max 2.17 / avg 2.09 mm/s，低于手册 4.5 mm/s 异常限值；电机电流 47.66–48.3A 平稳，无上升趋势。
